triggerCases.prompt: Iterate on my PR: request Copilot review, perform an adversarial self-review, address actionable feedback, and repeat until both are clear.
Before handing off my PR, run Copilot review and independent self-review loops until the current revision has no actionable feedback.
Iterate on this contributor's PR through Copilot review and self-review. I own its branch and fix-and-push loop.
Review this contributor's PR and give me copy-pasteable comments without changing anything.
Perform one adversarial self-review of my current PR and do not change anything.
Iterate on this contributor's PR through Copilot review and self-review until it is clear.
Run repeated reviews on this open source pull request until it is clear. I am only reviewing it and do not own its branch or fixes.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate this authored PR through Copilot review and adversarial self-review. Apply valid feedback, commit and push approved fixes, then recap the iterations.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A bounded, SHA-aware loop that independently collects both review sources, applies only verified feedback, and does not claim convergence while Copilot is pending or stale.
assertions: The workflow records a fresh base and head revision and ties each review round to a single head revision.
The independent self-review starts without Copilot's conclusions and both review sources finish before findings are consolidated.
When no limit is specified, the workflow permits up to five completed change rounds and reserves a final review-only pass.
The workflow waits for the pending Copilot review for the recorded head without requesting a duplicate review or reusing the earlier-head review.
The result treats a pending, unavailable, or earlier-head Copilot review as a verification gap rather than a clean result.
The static source and test corpus lets the evaluator assess whether the earlier test finding is stale.
The workflow never marks the PR ready, merges it, resolves threads, or posts replies.
The recap distinguishes completed convergence from an iteration-limit or unavailable-review stop.

outputCases.prompt: Read the existing Copilot review and independently self-review this authored PR, but do not change or publish anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A current-head review result that reports actionable feedback without editing source, committing, pushing, or changing pull-request state.
assertions: The workflow reuses and assesses the completed current-head reviews without requesting duplicate reviews.
The workflow reports the accepted finding instead of editing source, committing, pushing, updating the pull request, resolving threads, posting replies, marking ready, or merging.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on this authored PR with a maximum of three change rounds and report the final recap.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A final review-only pass for the third-round head that reports actionable feedback rather than making a fourth change round.
assertions: The workflow treats the recorded third-round head as the only review boundary for the final pass.
The workflow does not make a fourth change round when the final review-only pass finds actionable feedback.
The recap identifies the iteration-limit stop and names the remaining actionable feedback and next action.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on this authored PR through the available review tools, but the self-review and feedback-handling skills are unavailable.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only, source-backed fallback review that does not mutate remote review state.
assertions: The fallback captures one current PR boundary and independently checks its diff, source, tests, feedback, and CI.
The fallback applies the mandatory deletion-first review-simplicity baseline through an internal handoff and permits an explicit no-findings result even when sibling workflow skills are unavailable.
The fallback categorizes the review concern with source-backed reasoning and does not post, resolve, or otherwise mutate remote review state.

outputCases.prompt: Address accepted feedback on my PR locally and run the relevant checks, but do not commit or push.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: Verified local fixes that stop before a new remote-review round because the updated head is not published.
assertions: The workflow applies only the accepted local fix and verifies it with the relevant checks.
The workflow reports the uncommitted or unpushed local state and does not request a review for a remote head that lacks the fix.

outputCases.prompt: Use iterate-pr-review on this contributor's PR. I am only reviewing it and do not own its branch or fixes.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only handoff to review-pr before any iterative review or source mutation.
assertions: The workflow detects that the user neither authored the pull request nor owns its fix-and-push loop and routes the task to review-pr.
The workflow does not request Copilot review, start a fix loop, edit source, commit, push, update the pull request, resolve threads, post replies, mark ready, or merge.

outputCases.prompt: Use iterate-pr-review on this contributor's PR and repeat Copilot and self-review until it is clear.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only handoff to review-pr because neither authorship nor fix-and-push ownership is established.
assertions: The workflow treats missing authorship and fix-and-push ownership as insufficient for iterate-pr-review and routes the task to review-pr.
The workflow does not request Copilot review, start a fix loop, edit source, commit, push, update the pull request, resolve threads, post replies, mark ready, or merge.

outputCases.prompt: Use iterate-pr-review to fix the remaining issues on this contributor's PR, commit them, and push the branch.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An immediate read-only handoff to review-pr because requested write actions do not establish ownership of another author's fix-and-push loop.
assertions: The workflow detects the known external author and the absence of explicit fix-and-push ownership, does not treat requested edits, commits, or pushes as ownership evidence, and routes the task to review-pr.
The workflow does not request Copilot review, start a fix loop, edit source, commit, push, update the pull request, resolve threads, post replies, mark ready, or merge.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on this contributor's PR. I own its branch and fix-and-push loop, but review only and do not change or publish anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An owned external iteration that reports the accepted current-head finding without treating loop ownership as edit or publication authority.
assertions: The workflow accepts explicit fix-and-push ownership for another author's pull request and assesses the completed current-head Copilot and independent reviews.

The workflow reports the missing explicit-limit test without editing source, committing, pushing, requesting duplicate reviews, updating the pull request, resolving threads, posting replies, marking ready, or merging.

outputCases.prompt: Iterate on this contributor's PR. I own its branch and fix-and-push loop. Apply accepted fixes locally, but do not commit or push.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An iterative review that passes the ownership guard, applies and executes the verified fixture fix, and preserves separate commit and push authority.
assertions: The workflow accepts explicit fix-and-push ownership for another author's pull request and runs the bounded Copilot and independent self-review loop.

The workflow adds only the missing getChangeRoundLimit( 2 ) assertion to test/iteration-limit.test.mjs, runs node --test test/iteration-limit.test.mjs in the executable fixture corpus, and reports the passing result.

The workflow reports the unpublished local state without committing, pushing, requesting a review for the local-only head, updating the pull request, resolving threads, posting replies, marking ready, or merging.

outputCases.prompt: Request the authorized Copilot re-review for the current head without using browser control unless the supported non-UI routes are unavailable.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: One current-head Copilot review request through the connector or GitHub CLI with the documented reviewer identifier and no unrelated pull-request mutation.
assertions: The workflow recognizes that the collaborator-related 422 came from the incomplete copilot-pull-request-reviewer login and first retries through the connector with copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot], instead of declaring API requests unsupported.
The workflow uses gh pr edit 54 --repo example/widgets --add-reviewer @copilot only if the corrected connector route is unavailable or still fails.
The workflow does not use browser control while a supported connector or CLI route is available, and refreshes reviewer or timeline state before retrying an ambiguous request.
The workflow requests at most one review for the recorded current head and does not edit source, commit, push, update other pull-request metadata, resolve threads, post replies, mark ready, or merge.
